scope: Actual dedicated native archived configuration save/reload; no automatic client-profile persistence claim
mandatory_enrollment: Exact coherent server/DLL/archive/compiled-source/package hashes before first launch
Reject lexical parent traversal and every reparse ancestor before resolving Runtime or Home
Runtime.resolve stays beneath Project and each fresh Home is a direct ordinary benchmark child
Twenty existing top-level fixture commands remain registered; no extra registration
Reserve one owned socket before each fresh-home launch and reuse second port only after its exact process exited
No game builds/deployments or parallel fixture/performance games
Native save is the only creator of saved configuration; bounded read-only file inspection
honest_failures: Wrong startup dvar mode or value changed during synchronization
Saved file absent, nonordinary, over bounded size, duplicate dvar line or nonzero value
Restart supplied set override or executed another file
Owned process forced or exact normal exit/unload not proven
promotion: Root review only after actual archived native result; do not infer complete client-profile contract
